levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reports the spot as fine after only a quick glance at the top layer, without lifting or moving anything.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Checks layer by layer and finds at least two specific errors in the storage spot.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Checks layer by layer, finds at least two specific errors, and also checks a second storage spot unprompted.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Names an error but leaves it unfixed, or the fix does not actually resolve the specific problem described.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both named errors are corrected, and the spot is checked again afterward.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Both errors are corrected, and the learner explains why the harder-to-notice error was easy to miss.

lookFors: Each named error is specific (a named item and what was wrong with it), not a vague 'it was messy.'
The reflection response distinguishes the easy-to-notice error from the hard-to-notice one with a clear reason.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
